anya-support: FYI incoming support ticket from Euronet GmbH (cust=98765). Invoice INV-2026-334 is blocked — system flagged VAT as NOT_VALID in VIES and PO#5509 requires reverse-charge exemption. Need guidance for manual processing.

luis-billing: Thanks @anya-support. Can you paste the exact VAT string they submitted + the uploaded doc name? If VIES returns NOT_VALID we usually need national registry proof or a signed resale certificate before we can apply tax-exempt processing. :thinking:

anya-support: VAT they submitted: DE123456789-002 (branch suffix). Uploaded file: euronet_resale_cert.jpg (OCR read: "Euronet GmbH, DE123456789-002, VAT office Berlin"). Upload link: https://redwood.internal/uploads/98765

kai-legal: Branch suffixes commonly cause VIES to return NOT_VALID. Two quick options: 1) try the root legal entity id (DE123456789) in VIES, 2) ask customer for national registry confirmation (German BZSt or official VAT lookup) OR a signed resale certificate on company letterhead (must match billed legal entity). EU VIES ref: https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/ :link:

sophia-support: Agent repro steps (short):
1) Normalize VAT (remove branch suffix/non-alphanum).
2) Query VIES with root id.
3) If NOT_VALID, request either (a) national VAT lookup screenshot or (b) signed resale certificate PDF that includes company legal name, VAT id, signature + date.
4) Ensure PO PDF includes explicit reverse-charge or resale clause.

luis-billing: Manual override checklist (what finance needs):
- Signed resale certificate (PDF, legible)
- PO showing reverse charge clause
- Billing contact + email
- Confirmation from legal that national lookup is acceptable (if provided)
Once we have these, finance can open a FIN case and approve a one-off net invoice release. Tagging @kai-legal for legal signoff.

kai-legal: Confirming: a national VAT lookup screenshot (official site) is acceptable. If they provide a parent company doc it must NOT be used unless the billed legal entity is identical. Resale certs must explicitly state resale/reverse-charge or similar.

anya-support: Customer asked if a screenshot of the BZSt search is ok — they attached one showing the root id as "valid" but VIES still reports NOT_VALID. Also they said the uploaded file was a JPG photo (poor scan).

sophia-support: Helpful snippet for normalization we use in repros:
```
const normalize = (vat) => vat.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g,'');
normalize('DE123456789-002') // -> 'DE123456789002'
// for VIES try root: 'DE123456789'
```
Try both forms and attach both responses to the ticket.

invoice-bot: Created billing case FIN-2026-2105 for customer 98765. Assigned to luis-billing. Link: https://redwood.internal/finance/FIN-2026-2105 :white_check_mark:

luis-billing: I asked the customer to upload: 1) signed resale cert PDF (not jpg), 2) national VAT search screenshot, 3) PO. Offered one-time manual release for invoice INV-2026-334 if docs arrive by EOD tomorrow. Note: switching payment method to card doesn't bypass tax validation — the exemption must be validated first.

anya-support: Customer replied: they will upload a signed certificate but claim VIES intermittently returns SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE when including branch suffix. They attached BZSt screenshot showing the root id valid.

kai-legal: That's fine. National registry screenshot + signed resale cert = acceptable evidence. Finance, please flag FIN-2026-2105 for temporary net release on receipt. @luis-billing please confirm before releasing.

luis-billing: Agreed. I'll mark invoice as 'released-pending-evidence' in the system and set a 7d hold window. If evidence is not received within 7d we'll re-open and re-bill with VAT and possible chargeback.

sophia-support: Adding internal repro note to ticket: "VIES may fail on branch suffixes. Normalize then check national registry. If registry confirms ownership, accept and escalate to finance for manual net release."

anya-support: Customer will upload signed PDF to support portal. I'll update FIN case when the PDF arrives and ping @luis-billing to finalize. :white_check_mark:
